notes.title: Patch Notes #7 for November 7.
notes.content:
[h2][b]Nov, 7 Patch Note (Ver.0.661) [/b][/h2]

[h3][b]New Feature[/b][/h3]
[b]Unit upgrade[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38627417/85e050ef9f31b9bcf383072142edee81a438a397.gif[/img]

Now players can upgrade units. One of following five upgrade icons appears at the shop.
 - Power: Gold 3, Power +1
 - Defense: Gold 3, Defense +1
 - Health: Gold 3, Health: +3
 - Cost: Gold 10, Cost -1
 - Range: Gold 5, Unit gains ranged.
Units can be upgraded multiple times regardless of upgrade type.

[h3][b]Localization[/b][/h3]
 - Corrected some Portuguese sentences.

[h3][b]Bug Fix[/b][/h3]
 - Fixed "Fury" and "Divine power" effects do not reflect results for battle preview properly.

notes.title: Patch Notes #5 for October 22.
notes.content:
[b]Oct, 22 Patch Note (Ver.0.65) [/b]

[b]Added features.[/b]
Many players find it difficult to choose units for battle because it is very hard to estimate fight orders and damages at a glance. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38627417/4db00f2d2be135256d72837e810bee7bd428ef0e.gif[/img]

We added following features in order to make it easier to predict the outcome of the battle.
 - Battle preview: Shows units stats changed in advance according to player's selection.
 - Target preview: Displays who is targeting whom.
Players can also turn on/off these features on setting panel.

[b]Rework[/b]
Reworked some of "Dark Gambler" units because they have random skills which make players feel complicated and confused. 
 - Sword Mage
Skill: Aleatory Dagger --> Strike
Target: First enemy --> Random enemy

[b]Balance[/b]
Quest
 - Increase the reward for "Difficult Personality" from 5 to 10.
Unit
 - Angel Knight
Stats: Power 2/ Defense 1/ Health 18 --> 2/1/15

[b]Localization[/b]
 - Updated Russian localization for several words.

[b]Bug Fix[/b]
 - Fixed a problem where units were not properly sorted according to categories when classifying characters in the team edit mode.
 - Fixed cost for stage reroll button is not updated when players continue game.
 - Fixed some of units' animations.

notes.title: Patch Notes #2 for October 13.
notes.content:
Oct, 13 Patch Note (Ver.0.63)

I got some feedback from users that they want to start game with their own team. 

I just decide to let [b]players choose make their starting team with unlocked units but limited to 4 units and 5 total cost. [/b]This change will let players start how they want to with small team. 
It also motivates players to find others source due to the limitation of the starting units to win the game, which makes every run different.

Changes
 Prevented players from overwhelming enemies with the number of units:
- Shop is not open until player clear first stage.
- The number of unit slots starts from 4 and increase by 1 whenever player clear stage. 

Narrowed down the unit pool based on Trial level for beginners not to feel overwhelming with tons of information:
- Units on the shop are limited to units who were opponents in the previous stage or will be in the next stage.

Localization
- Updated English and Russian localization for several expressions and words.

Thank you!

Jinny Ku.

notes.title: Patch Notes #1 for October 12.
notes.content:
Oct, 12 Patch Note (Ver.0.62) 

I found many of user who played a couple of campaigns think that it is very easy to make a specific build. If you already edit your team like a “Dream team” from start, it can induce players to stay in their comfort zone. There is no reason to find units to make new combinations and synergy because they are already strong enough. (There is nothing lacking, so there is nothing more to do)

As s consequence the game will become repetitive and boring. The stronger the initial characters are, more the game becomes repetitive. [b]So I decide to make starting units unchangeable.[/b] I hope user to experience a different play each campaign with different team.

But I also have a plan to make team editable with a different mode or different way in the near future.

[b]Changes[/b]
 - Decreased number of starting units from 7 to 4.
 - Starting units are not changeable.
 - At trial level 0, only 2 kinds of enemies show up for each stage and the number of kinds of units increase as trial level goes up.
 - Increased default reward for stage clear from 4 to 5.
 - The price of units at the shop is equal to their costs(e.g. Cost 3 unit = Gold 3).
 - Reward units are limited to enemies who were opponents in the previous stage.
 - Replaced the word "Skill" for unit to "Power". 
The number of starting enemy units no more increase by trial level.
 - Trial Level 1: The number of starting enemy units increases.(4) --> Stage clear reward decreases.(4)
 - Trial Level 7: The number of starting enemy units increases.(5) --> The Health recovery of the hero decreases.(4)
 - Trial Level 13: The number of starting enemy units increases.(6) --> The Health recovery of the hero decreases.(2)
 - Trial Level 19: The number of starting enemy units increases.(7) --> Stage clear reward decreases.(2)

[b]Improvement[/b]
 - Made tutorial simple and easy to clear.

[b]Localization[/b]
 - Updated Russian localization for several expressions and words.

[b]Balance[/b]
Units
 - Chief: Health 21 -->19
 - Cupid: Power 5 -->7
 - Fish Keeper: Health 14 -->12
 - Healer: Power 3 -->4
Item
 - Devil's Amulet: Gold 4 --> 7
